features.title: Add a slugify utility
features.description: Create src/strings/slugify.ts exporting `slugify(s: string): string` that lowercases, trims, replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters with single hyphens, and strips leading/trailing hyphens. Add tests/slugify.test.ts covering: basic phrase, leading/trailing punctuation, unicode/space collapsing, and the empty string.

features.title: Add a truncate utility
features.description: Create src/strings/truncate.ts exporting `truncate(s: string, max: number): string` that returns s unchanged when it fits, else cuts to `max` characters total INCLUDING a trailing ellipsis '…'. Add tests/truncate.test.ts covering: short string unchanged, exact-length boundary, long string truncated with ellipsis, and max smaller than the ellipsis.
